summary: A static, light pricing page (#fafafa ground, near-black type) at 1244x996; nothing moves across the 3 s (frame differences between 0 s, 0.5 s, 1.5 s, 2 s and 2.9 s are zero). Top nav bar 0–48 px with a hairline under it: Chatbase logo (bold black mark and wordmark) at left x≈129, centred links "Product ⌄ Solutions ⌄ Resources ⌄ Customers Enterprise Pricing" in 12–13 px dark grey, and a white outlined "Login" pill at right (x≈1060–1114). The hero is centred on x≈622: a two-line headline "Predictable pricing / scalable plans" (~64 px, medium weight, black, tight leading, y≈95–215), a grey subline "Designed for every stage of your journey." at y≈235, a segmented toggle (grey track 526–718 × 266–298 with a white raised "Monthly" thumb on the left and grey "Yearly" on the right), and a pink–orange gradient check badge with "20% off yearly plans" at y≈326. Behind the hero, on both sides, runs a very faint set of vertical hairlines (about 4 per side, ~52 px apart, from y≈95 to ≈365) that fade at top and bottom. Below sits one wide white card (x 129–1114, top y≈376, large ~16 px top radius, runs off the bottom) split by 1 px light-grey dividers into five equal 197 px columns: Free, Hobby, Standard, Pro, Enterprise. Each column has a small coloured icon + 15 px name (y≈406), a large ~30 px light-weight price ($0, $40, $150, $500, "Let's Talk") with grey "per month" under it, an outlined white button with ~8 px radius at y≈554–591, a horizontal divider at y≈605, then an "Everything in X +" lead and a checkmark feature list at 29 px rhythm, some items dotted-underlined. The Standard column is the highlight: a black "Popular" tab with rounded top corners sits on top of it (524–720 × 354–376) and its button is solid black (543–701 × 548–586) with a rounded orange-to-pink-to-violet gradient lip showing 5–6 px under it.

criteria.check: Nothing moves: the page at 0.5s and at 2.5s is identical, no element shifts, fades or changes colour
Background is a flat very light grey (#fafafa), not pure white and not tinted
A 1px light-grey hairline runs the full width under the nav at y≈48
Logo (mark + bold 'Chatbase') sits at the left, starting x≈129, vertically centred at y≈24
Nav reads exactly 'Product', 'Solutions', 'Resources' (each with a small down chevron), 'Customers', 'Enterprise', 'Pricing' in that order
'Login' is in a white rounded button with a thin light border at the right edge, ending x≈1114
Headline reads 'Predictable pricing' on line 1 and 'scalable plans' on line 2
Headline is near-black, about 64px cap-to-descender per line, medium weight with tight letter-spacing, centred on x≈622
Subline reads 'Designed for every stage of your journey.' in mid grey (clearly lighter than the headline), ~16px, centred at y≈235
Toggle is a light-grey rounded track (~192x33) with a white raised thumb under 'Monthly' on the left half; 'Yearly' sits on the grey track, unselected
'Monthly' is dark and medium weight; 'Yearly' is lighter grey
A ~14px round badge filled with a pink-to-orange gradient carrying a white checkmark sits left of the text
Text reads '20% off yearly plans', dark grey, centred at y≈326
Faint vertical hairlines (about 4 per side, ~52px apart) appear in the hero margins left of x≈290 and right of x≈955, between y≈95 and y≈365
Stripes are barely visible 1px lines that fade out at top and bottom; NOT solid grey bars, NOT a full grid with horizontal lines
A black tab spans exactly the Standard column width (x 524–720), from y≈354 to the card top at y≈376
Tab has rounded top corners (~10px) and square bottom, and reads 'Popular' in small white text centred
Card spans x 129–1114 starting at y≈376 and runs off the bottom of the frame
Card is white with a thin light-grey border and a large (~16px) radius on its top-left and top-right corners
Card is split into 5 equal columns (~197px) by 1px light-grey vertical dividers at x≈327, 524, 720, 917
One horizontal 1px divider crosses all columns at y≈605, under the buttons
Column titles read 'Free', 'Hobby', 'Standard', 'Pro', 'Enterprise', ~15px medium black at y≈406
Free has a green four-point sparkle glyph
Hobby has a blue five-point star
Standard has an orange/amber six-point asterisk-like star
Pro has a pink eight-point burst
Enterprise has a red-orange ring (hollow circle), not a filled dot
Prices read '$0', '$40', '$150', '$500', and 'Let's Talk' across the five columns
Prices are ~30px, light/regular weight near-black, baseline at y≈482, left-aligned at each column's inner x (149, 346, 543, 740, 937)
'per month' in small (~10px) grey appears under the first four prices at y≈497; none under 'Let's Talk'
Buttons read 'Get started', 'Start 7-day trial', 'Start 7-day trial' (Standard), 'Start 7-day trial', 'Contact us'
Free, Hobby, Pro and Enterprise buttons are white with a 1px light-grey border, ~8px radius, 158x38 at y≈554, label dark medium ~13px centred
Standard's button is solid black with white 'Start 7-day trial' ~14px, ~8px radius, sitting about 6px higher (top y≈548) than the outlined buttons
Under the black button a 5–6px rounded lip shows a horizontal gradient from orange (left) through pink to violet (right)
The lip is a smooth gradient band hugging the button's bottom corners; NOT a flat single-colour border, NOT a blurred glow spreading around the button
Columns 2–5 open with 'Everything in Free +', 'Everything in Hobby +', 'Everything in Standard +', 'Everything in Pro +' at y≈633, medium dark
Free lists 'Limited access to models' (underlined), '50 message credits/month', '1 member' with check marks
Grey small note reads 'AI agents get deleted after 14 days of inactivity on the free plan.' at y≈743–769
Hobby has 6 checked items: Access to advanced models, 700 message credits/month, 2 members, Integrations, Basic analytics, Attachments
Standard has 11 checked items ending with 'Advanced integrations (Stripe, Zendesk, and more)' wrapping to three lines ending y≈975
Pro has 5 checked items: 15,000 message credits/month, 5 members, Advanced analytics, Sources suggestions, Tickets as a source
Enterprise has 10 checked items from 'Higher limits' to 'HIPAA-eligible'
Some items carry a thin dotted/dashed underline (e.g. Helpdesk, Voice, Telephony, Advanced analytics, Flexible billing) while others (e.g. 3 members, API access, SSO) do not
Single-line feature rows are spaced ~29px apart, check glyph at column x+8 and text starting ~25px right of it
Checks are thin dark stroked tick marks (~12px), no circle or fill behind them
